description.value: Vedder Sushi is a Japanese and Asian fusion sushi restaurant in Sardis/Chilliwack, operated by a chef with 40 years of experience. The menu features an extensive list of specialty rolls alongside sashimi and other Japanese fare, all made with fresh ingredients and no MSG. Online ordering and takeout are available, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Vedder Sushi is an active Japanese takeout/restaurant at #8-7300 Vedder Road, Chilliwack, BC, with phone 604-824-9880. The site explicitly promotes online ordering and takeout ('Order online', 'Takeaway food', 'To Your Door'). No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities.
concerns: OSM record has no address; address sourced from website only. OSM community is listed as 'Sardis' but website/address says 'Chilliwack' — these overlap geographically but may warrant a tag correction.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant with confirmed website, phone, and address. A valid food stop for touring cyclists in the Chilliwack/Sardis area.
